notes.title: Multiple Daily GoldenCube Drops!
notes.content:
Welcome to ICE! 2.0!

New Changes:

1. more stable inventory system.
2. GoldenCubes can be won either by playing ICE! or through timed drops!

*GoldenCubes will be included in ICE! wins and in-game drops! The game will show you when you win a GoldenCube with a notification screen.

**sell your GoldenCube on the Steam Marketplace for $10, and we'll buy it!
